summary: Completed frontend-only validation for Photography gallery option A on the public preview URL. Desktop editorial grid, media loading/playback, lightbox behavior, mobile single-column flow, overflow checks, and preservation of surrounding Photography sections all passed.
critical_code_review_comments: App.css contains multiple historical .masonry blocks before the final override; behavior is currently correct, but redundant definitions increase future regression risk if order changes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified on https://exp-gallery-2.preview.emergentagent.com/photography at 1920x1080 and 390x844. Confirmed 5-tile flush arrangement, portrait video spanning two rows on right, landscape video in bottom wide area, all 3 images loaded, both videos played with controls, lightbox open/close works, no horizontal overflow desktop/mobile, and intro/Instagram/process/header/footer are intact.
rca of the issue: No blocking issue reproduced in this iteration. Two console 'net::ERR_ABORTED' lines appeared for video URLs during page lifecycle, but both videos successfully loaded metadata and played; treated as non-blocking aborted duplicate requests rather than a functional media failure.
